verdict.rationale: User reported: after a token-limit failure the thought shows Failed live but Success after a reload. Cause: the UI flags a thought in browser memory only; the backend saves the 'Codemie Thoughts' thought without error. Decision: fix in the backend (Thought.error already exists in the model and both SDKs; no SDK change).

First version marked failed thoughts at persistence (in-progress ones, else the last top-level thought), mirroring the UI guess. Rejected by the user: the backend knows which LLM call was truncated, so a guess is wrong by design. Reverted before push (reset --keep, nothing pushed).

Precise fix only, no fallbacks: flag the thought keyed by the truncated AIMessage.id via on_thought_failed before raising TokenLimitExceededException; no-op when no thought is open; resend with empty message to avoid duplicating text; invalid_tool_calls path flags before _on_llm_end (finalize-then-raise order kept, existing test unchanged).
follow_ups: timeouts and failures with no identifiable thought are not flagged
